record.paper_title: Classification of Finite Groups: Recent Developements and Open Problems
record.original_question: Determine all groups of order p^8, for a prime p, up to isomorphism. The paper describes this as a highly challenging classification problem and indicates that any successful solution should rely on computational methods together with symbolic computation.

evidence.quote: Problem 7 Determine the groups of order p 8. This seems a highly challenging problem and its solution should deﬁnitely be based on computational methods and symbolic computations.

artifact.self_contained_problem: For a prime number $p$, classify, up to isomorphism, all finite groups of order $p^8$. That is, produce a complete and irredundant list of isomorphism class representatives of groups $G$ with $|G| = p^8$, parametrized by $p$, together with explicit presentations (for example, power–commutator presentations) for each isomorphism type.
artifact.status_search_result: The full classification of all groups of order $p^8$ for general primes $p$ remains open. Groups of order dividing $p^7$ were classified by Newman, O'Brien, and Vaughan-Lee (2004–2005). Partial progress on order $p^8$ exists: Vaughan-Lee classified groups of order $p^8$ and exponent $p$ (2014), but the full classification across all exponents and all primes is not complete.

status_evidence.title: Groups of order p^8 and exponent p — Michael Vaughan-Lee
status_evidence.snippet: Vaughan-Lee classifies the groups of order p^8 with exponent p, a special subclass of the order p^8 problem.
status_evidence.claim: Only a restricted subclass (exponent p) of groups of order p^8 has been classified, indicating the full problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: The groups with order p^7 for odd prime p
status_evidence.snippet: O'Brien and Vaughan-Lee classified groups of order p^7 for odd primes p.
status_evidence.claim: Classification stops at p^7; p^8 is the next open case.

status_evidence.title: Classification of Finite Groups: Recent Developments and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Lists determining groups of order p^8 as an open problem requiring computational and symbolic methods.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly stated as open in a recent survey.
